title: Julie D NDE 2142
content: I was having difficulty breathing. There was a doctor to my left and two nurses with him. He was injecting my IV and asking me why I couldn't breathe. I was now lying flat on my back looking at the ceiling. I had an oxygen mask on my face and it was becoming more and more difficult to breathe. Other nurses have now entered my room, one is to my left, and she takes off my oxygen mask and holds that thing on me with the big blue ball type thing. She is yelling at me to breathe saying, 'Don't do this,' as she says my name. I look up at the ceiling and suddenly I knew I was going and it was okay. For a moment in time, everything seemed to freeze. My entire body just froze; maybe it was for a second. Then the most amazing, most incredible feeling, if you can call it that had come over me. I want to try to explain this feeling. There was no negativity at all. None. No longing. No missing anyone. It was pure. If there is pure love, I had touched it. I was still totally alive although my body was not. My spirit was as vibrant as it is right now, maybe more so. I could see that one nurse trying so hard to get me to breath. Then I heard the heart-alarm go off. I knew I wasn't alone. It had to have been only seconds and I felt something pull me back. What made this experience so life altering is I felt so guilty afterwards because once I came back, I didn't want to be here. I didn't miss my children. I wanted to stay where I was. So I find myself to this day searching for this 'love' which I fear I will never find. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: February 2000 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Yes Surgery-related Clinical death (cessation of breathing or heart function or brain function) I had been bleeding internally and had a second surgery to stop it. I was recovering when I went into respiratory arrest, stopped breathing and then cardiac arrest. How do you consider the content of your experience? Wonderful Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal It would seem that things were more defined, clear. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? I believe I was the entire time. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Saw them Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? Neither Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Neither What emotions did you feel during the experience? This is the most difficult to put into words. There is no word to express it. Pure Love. No negative. Nothing dark whatsoever. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate I was a firm believer in Jesus Christ Have your religious practices changed since your experience? Yes What is your religion now? Moderate I no longer believe in Jesus Christ but have a faith in God that no one can take from me. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? Yes Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Definite being, or voice clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? Yes This too is difficult to explain, but you seem to return with a certain knowing. You can't pin point it to a certain question but when the question comes you will know the answer. Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes I am not in contact with anyone who does not believe me concerning this experience. That includes my best friend of twenty years. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? Yes Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain When I returned, during my recovery two 'spirits' stayed with me in my room until I was well. They were clearly there to do a job. Are there one or several parts of your experience that are especially meaningful or significant to you? This experience has totally changed my life. I am not the person I was before it happened. It is as if my spirit was renewed. The down side of it is that it has changed my views on Jesus, which I grew up believing, so that has been difficult. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes I believe it frightens most people and they don't believe me. It is rather a lonely feeling. Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real I was dying. The doctors knew it. The nurses knew it. I had this experience and two weeks later, I was healed. It was real. The nurses called it a miracle. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No
